title: The Cipher of the Lost Tomb
motive: Ownership of an unearthed ancient golden tomb cylinder.

timeline.event: Museum doors locked for the night.
Prof. Montgomery deciphers final cylinder inscription in private study.
Security guard hears glass smashing in Egyptian wing.

dialogue_placeholders.suspect_006: I was catering late for the museum trustees board.
dialogue_placeholders.suspect_007: Professor Montgomery promised me co-authorship on the discovery paper!
dialogue_placeholders.suspect_016: The artifact belonged in the central library vault, not his desk.
dialogue_placeholders.suspect_019: I funded the entire expedition! I deserved first rights!
